scalar_types.TickPeriod: TickPeriod(*, numerator: int, denominator: int) -> TickPeriod; both positive, reduce canonically using fractions.Fraction
scalar_types.SIValue: finite Decimal, never float/NaN/Infinity; fixed state/input tuple lengths retain SI and canonical order

scalar_types.Unknown: None plus nonempty UnknownField(field: str, reason: str); never substitute a zero or a safe outcome

validation_strategy: Constructors are exact kw-only value objects; all named fields required except Reduction.endpoint_outputs fixed empty. Recursively freeze inputs and validate ranges, finite decimals, tuple lengths, uniqueness and reference closure.
Codec uses strict duplicate-key rejection, finite exact decimal parsing and explicit version selection. No arbitrary object deserialization, pickle, dynamic imports or inference from truthiness.
Configuration checks the fixed reviewed activation set, canonical clock mappings/authorization assumptions and immutable source/context binding.
seal_batch does not mutate Snapshot; reduce_batch rechecks its configuration/snapshot fingerprints and admission invariants to reject stale or forged SealedBatch inputs.
Malformed external records produce DecodeFailure/Denial, no default valid state or grant; invariant corruption of persisted Snapshot goes through restore_snapshot fail-closed path.

Equivalent valid initial records and event sequence produce byte-identical canonical outputs. No random IDs: trace identity is control_session_id/batch_id/event_id/phase/microstep/record_index with explicit integer fields.
Snapshot history is logical input/output, not filesystem or power durability. The reducer never creates a physical/synthetic endpoint application, acknowledgement or rest measurement.
PC10 reject_batch must be used for classified seal/record failures; no valid known critical observation can be discarded by a global early return.
dependency_limit: Python standard library only for runtime; pytest is already present for separately authorized future tests. No dependency or package-wide initialization change.
